notes: Removed the Freshdesk-backed Support tab and Freshdesk connection settings — Freshdesk is permanently retired, and Tickets is now the only place ticket support happens. Fixed pressing a Moderation shortcut key (like the Deny reason letters) sometimes popping open a new email Compose window on top of it.

windows_notes: Added a "Deny Hotkeys" settings panel in Moderation, so the Deny dialog's reason shortcuts can be seen and rebound — hovering a reason now shows its key too. Fixed the User panel sometimes showing the wrong artist's contact info after clicking through tickets quickly. Fixed emails sometimes moving to Trash while replying to a different one, if you started typing very quickly after clicking Reply.
